scope: Executed finite protocol models; no production control store or CDC implementation exists here

cases.name: separate_lease_and_progress_keys
cases.observation: A stale owner publishes progress after B acquired a newer lease; the progress filename was still absent.

cases.name: unified_head_rejects_stale_parent
cases.observation: Lease takeover changes the same head version; A cannot publish against its old expected head.

cases.name: one_batch_ahead_without_original_intent
cases.observation: Matching batch numbers hide a different input range after an intent-losing restore; adoption would acknowledge unwritten input.

cases.name: generation_scoped_dedup_is_not_reset_fencing
cases.observation: A sink that deduplicates only by (generation,batch) accepts both generations; separate reset fencing must be proved for each real sink.

cases.name: independent_flow_leases_shared_cdc_target
cases.kind: draft counterexample under explicit frozen-source premise
cases.observation: A reconciles upsert 10; B completes delete 20; A inserts 10 after B. Per-flow leases and per-table atomic merges do not establish target-wide CDC isolation. Not an observed Spark/Sail runtime defect.

cases.name: cdc_requires_all_effect_receipts
cases.observation: An auxiliary-only receipt cannot advance the whole CDC batch; confirmation must cover every required durable effect.
